# wa-format

> Bidirectional WhatsApp formatting library: `toHTML` converts WhatsApp-formatted
> text into safe HTML; `toWA` converts supported HTML back into WhatsApp markup.
> Zero-dependency core (only the MCP server pulls the protocol SDK). Isomorphic:
> Node ≥20 and modern browsers. ESM + CJS + TypeScript declarations.

- Site: https://wa-format.os.darcas.app/
- Repo: https://github.com/DarCas/wa-format
- Package: @darcas/wa-format v0.5.0
- License: MIT

## Install

```bash
npm i @darcas/wa-format
```

Browser:

```html
<script type="module">
    import {toHTML} from "https://esm.sh/@darcas/wa-format"
    document.querySelector("#message").innerHTML = toHTML("*Hello* _world_")
</script>
```

## The two functions

```ts
import {toHTML, toWA} from "@darcas/wa-format"

toHTML("*Hello* _world_")          // "<b>Hello</b> <i>world</i>"
toWA("<b>Hello</b> <i>world</i>")  // "*Hello* _world_"
```

## Formatting table

| Format | WhatsApp | HTML |
|---|---|---|
| Bold | `*text*` | `<b>text</b>` |
| Italic | `_text_` | `<i>text</i>` |
| Strikethrough | `~text~` | `<s>text</s>` |
| Inline code | `` `text` `` | `<code>text</code>` |
| Code block | ` ```text``` ` | `<pre><code>text</code></pre>` |
| Block quote | `> text` | `<blockquote>text</blockquote>` |
| Bulleted list | `- text` or `* text` | `<ul><li>text</li></ul>` |
| Numbered list | `1. text` | `<ol><li>text</li></ol>` |

`*` is both bold and bullet: `* ` at line start is a list item; `*` touching
text is bold.

## The one guarantee

`toHTML(toWA(html)) === toHTML(html)` — HTML idempotence. `toWA` is best-effort
and lossy: WhatsApp has no escape character.

## MCP tools

Register `wa-format-mcp` over stdio. Tools: `whatsapp_to_html(text, style,
lineBreaks, trim)` and `html_to_whatsapp(html, bullet)`. Both read-only,
idempotent, non-destructive, closed-world.

## Facts

0 core dependencies · ESM + CJS + types · 80 tests · Node ≥20.
